speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked the Minister for Health whether the Ministry will consider making neo-natal insurance for IVF compulsory at the point of a positive pregnancy blood test rather than at the point of embryo transfer.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
text: This is in recognition of the higher risks and costs that these babies potentially face at birth.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
text: For example, couples undergoing IVF run a higher risk of multiple pregnancies, and this may result in the premature birth of babies who may need neo-natal intensive care.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
text: This makes the insurance premiums more affordable for all couples using IVF.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: One, what is the timeframe of this review?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Second, it is not just the time you sign up for the IVF insurance, but I am also wondering whether we can get more companies to offer this neo-natal insurance because, at this point, only one company offers it.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: If we can get more companies, then, obviously, the pricing might improve as well.

speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
text: But we will review this as necessary, going forward.
